content: HYROX hybrid training app landscape (2025-2026): HyTrack is the closest Apsis competitor — logs GPS runs, all 8 HYROX stations, and strength work in one timeline; AI Hybrid Load Balancer flags 15-20% strength drop during race blocks after 5 sessions; Race Simulation with target splits; $9.99/month Pro. ROXFIT is coaching-first: AI training partner, structured plans, load visualization but not a free-form logger. TrainRox: structured programs, Apple Watch, syncs HealthKit and Strava. None of these combine free-form lifting logging (Strong-speed) + free-form running + a unified load score in one offline app.
